    • createEvent

      public Event createEvent(String id, String name, String description, String organizerId, List<String> coOrganizerIds, String date, String time, String endTime, String location, String locationAddress, int capacity, Integer waitlistLimit, int waitlistCount, int confirmedCount, String posterImageUrl, double price, long registrationOpens, long registrationCloses, Long lotteryDrawDate, long createdAt, long updatedAt, List<String> tags, boolean geolocationEnabled, Integer geolocationRadius, String status, String qrCodeUrl, android.graphics.Bitmap qrCode, boolean isFlagged, int flagCount, Waitlist waitlist, GuestList guestList, boolean recurringEvent, boolean isPrivate)
      Creates an event with all parameters.
      Parameters:
      id - Unique identifier for the event.
      name - The name of the event.
      description - A brief description of the event.
      organizerId - The ID of the primary organizer.
      coOrganizerIds - A list of IDs for co-organizers.
      date - The date the event occurs.
      time - The start time of the event.
      endTime - The end time of the event.
      location - The name of the event location.
      locationAddress - The physical address of the event location.
      capacity - The maximum number of attendees.
      waitlistLimit - The maximum number of attendees allowed on the waitlist.
      waitlistCount - The current number of attendees on the waitlist.
      confirmedCount - The current number of confirmed attendees.
      posterImageUrl - The URL of the event's poster image.
      price - The ticket price for the event.
      registrationOpens - The timestamp when registration opens.
      registrationCloses - The timestamp when registration closes.
      lotteryDrawDate - The timestamp when the lottery draw occurs.
      createdAt - The timestamp when the event was created.
      updatedAt - The timestamp when the event was last updated.
      tags - A list of categories or tags for the event.
      geolocationEnabled - Whether geolocation validation is enabled.
      geolocationRadius - The radius for geolocation validation.
      status - The current status of the event (e.g., open, closed).
      qrCodeUrl - The URL of the event's QR code.
      qrCode - The Bitmap representation of the event's QR code.
      isFlagged - Whether the event has been flagged.
      flagCount - The number of times the event has been flagged.
      waitlist - The Waitlist object for the event.
      guestList - The GuestList object for the event.
      recurringEvent - Whether the event is recurring.
      isPrivate - Whether the event is private.
      Returns:
      The newly created and fully initialized event.
